mandate.business_decisions_use_cases: Standardize executive, finance, sales and operations reporting decisions in the authorized pilot fixture.
mandate.domain_entity_scope_exclusions: Domains sales/finance/customer/product; entities order, invoice, customer, session, ticket; excludes forecasts and employee performance decisions.
mandate.audience_reporting_consumers: CEO pack, finance close, sales dashboard, product dashboard and support report owners.
mandate.as_of_horizon: Fixture as-of 2026-08-22; historical comparison window explicitly defined per metric.
mandate.owners_stewards_approvers_reviewers: Named fixture roles for business owner, steward, finance, engineering, risk and consumer review.
mandate.systems_of_record: Authorized fixture snapshots SRC-01..SRC-08; authority remains with human owners.
mandate.classification_access_rights: Synthetic INTERNAL_AUTHORIZED fixture data; least privilege; no production access.
mandate.non_goals: No target setting, forecast, production query, dashboard mutation, backfill, certification or publication.

Weekly Active Accounts; distinct active accounts

metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Value of eligible orders entering BOOKED state net of approved order discounts.
metric_contracts.numerator_denominator_formula: SUM(gross-discount); denominator N/A; deterministic formula F-001
metric_contracts.aggregation_behavior: additive only across non-overlapping order slices
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: booked_at; calendar day/month; Asia/Bangkok; booking cohort
metric_contracts.unit_currency_fx_rounding: VNĐ; original currency converted using finance-approved daily FX; round display only
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: null amount quarantined; zero valid; dedupe order_id; late by booked_at; restate per close policy

metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Revenue posted to approved GL revenue accounts under finance policy.
metric_contracts.entity_grain_event_state: journal line; one GL line; posted_at; POSTED
metric_contracts.aggregation_behavior: additive after currency/account mapping and non-overlap
metric_contracts.dimensions_filters_inclusions_exclusions: DIM-01,DIM-02,DIM-03; approved revenue accounts; exclude reversals per policy
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: posted_at; accounting period; finance timezone; posting cohort
metric_contracts.unit_currency_fx_rounding: VNĐ reporting currency; finance FX and rounding policy
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: null blocked; zero retained; journal key dedupe; late close adjustment; formal restatement
metric_contracts.owner_steward_approver: Finance Controller; Finance Data Steward; CFO

metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Share of eligible sessions attributed to at least one eligible booked order within seven days.
metric_contracts.entity_grain_event_state: session cohort; one eligible session; conversion attribution; ELIGIBLE
metric_contracts.numerator_denominator_formula: distinct converted sessions / distinct eligible sessions; F-003
metric_contracts.aggregation_behavior: ratio of sums; never average slice ratios
metric_contracts.dimensions_filters_inclusions_exclusions: DIM-01,DIM-02,DIM-04; include consented eligible sessions; exclude bots/internal traffic
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: session start; 7-day attribution; Asia/Bangkok; session cohort
metric_contracts.unit_currency_fx_rounding: percentage; no currency; four-decimal calculation/two-decimal display
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: missing session link excluded with reason; zero denominator=NULL; dedupe session/event; late attribution restates open cohort
metric_contracts.owner_steward_approver: Growth Owner; Analytics Steward; Commercial Owner

metric_contracts.canonical_name_aliases: Closed Opportunity Win Rate; Win Rate
metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Share of eligible opportunities closed as won within the selected close cohort.
metric_contracts.entity_grain_event_state: opportunity; one closed opportunity; closed_at; WON/LOST
metric_contracts.numerator_denominator_formula: won eligible opportunities / all closed eligible opportunities; F-004
metric_contracts.aggregation_behavior: ratio of sums across mutually exclusive slices
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: closed_at; calendar month; Asia/Bangkok; close cohort
metric_contracts.unit_currency_fx_rounding: percentage; no FX; full precision then display rounding
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: unknown outcome blocked; zero denominator=NULL; dedupe opportunity_id; late stage correction restates disclosed period
metric_contracts.owner_steward_approver: Revenue Ops; CRM Steward; Sales Director

metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Net booked value per eligible booked order in the same cohort.
metric_contracts.entity_grain_event_state: order cohort; one order; booked_at; BOOKED
metric_contracts.numerator_denominator_formula: SUM(net booked value) / COUNT(DISTINCT eligible order_id); F-005
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: booked_at; calendar window; Asia/Bangkok; booking cohort
metric_contracts.unit_currency_fx_rounding: VNĐ/order; same FX as MET-001; display rounding only
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: null value blocked; zero valid; order dedupe; late booking restated per policy
metric_contracts.owner_steward_approver: Sales Ops; Data Steward; Commercial Owner

metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Median elapsed approved business minutes from ticket open to first human response.
metric_contracts.aggregation_behavior: recompute median from observations; never average medians
metric_contracts.dimensions_filters_inclusions_exclusions: DIM-01,DIM-02,DIM-06; include supported channels; exclude spam/automated-only
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: opened_at; weekly; Asia/Bangkok business calendar; opened cohort
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: unresponded tracked separately; zero valid; ticket dedupe; late correction disclosed
metric_contracts.owner_steward_approver: Support Ops; Support Data Steward; COO

metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Share of eligible paid invoices settled on or before approved due date.
metric_contracts.entity_grain_event_state: invoice; one paid invoice; paid_at; PAID
metric_contracts.numerator_denominator_formula: on-time eligible paid invoices / all eligible paid invoices; F-007
metric_contracts.dimensions_filters_inclusions_exclusions: DIM-01,DIM-02,DIM-03; include settled invoices; exclude disputed/test per finance policy
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: paid_at; monthly; finance timezone; paid cohort
metric_contracts.unit_currency_fx_rounding: percentage; currency not in ratio; standard display rounding
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: missing due date blocked; zero denominator=NULL; invoice dedupe; late payment correction restated

metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Distinct eligible accounts with at least one qualifying product event in a calendar week.
metric_contracts.numerator_denominator_formula: COUNT(DISTINCT eligible account_id); denominator N/A; F-008
metric_contracts.aggregation_behavior: non-additive across time or overlapping dimensions
metric_contracts.dimensions_filters_inclusions_exclusions: DIM-01,DIM-02,DIM-05; approved event list; exclude test/internal accounts
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: event time; calendar week; Asia/Bangkok; activity cohort
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: null account blocked; zero valid result; event dedupe; late events restate open week

metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Total settled invoice amount in reporting currency for eligible payments.
metric_contracts.entity_grain_event_state: payment/invoice; one settled invoice; paid_at; PAID
metric_contracts.numerator_denominator_formula: SUM(settled amount converted); denominator N/A; F-009
metric_contracts.dimensions_filters_inclusions_exclusions: DIM-01,DIM-02,DIM-03; eligible settled payments; exclude reversals
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: paid_at; daily/monthly; finance timezone; payment cohort
metric_contracts.unit_currency_fx_rounding: VNĐ; finance-approved FX by settlement date; minor-unit calculation
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: null amount blocked; zero retained; invoice/payment dedupe; restate under finance policy

metric_contracts.business_question_definition: Share of governed metric bindings meeting their approved freshness SLA at evaluation time.
metric_contracts.entity_grain_event_state: metric binding; one binding/run; evaluated_at; COMPLIANT/NONCOMPLIANT
metric_contracts.numerator_denominator_formula: compliant governed bindings / eligible governed bindings; F-010
metric_contracts.aggregation_behavior: ratio of sums for the same evaluation population
metric_contracts.dimensions_filters_inclusions_exclusions: DIM-01,DIM-02; governed active bindings only; exclude deprecated bindings after sunset
metric_contracts.time_window_timezone_cohort: evaluated_at; daily; UTC and displayed Asia/Bangkok; evaluation cohort
metric_contracts.unit_currency_fx_rounding: percentage; no currency; display rounding only
metric_contracts.null_zero_duplicate_late_restatement: missing run is noncompliant per approved rule; zero denominator=NULL; binding dedupe; no silent restatement
metric_contracts.owner_steward_approver: Data Governance; Analytics Steward; Data Governance Council

risks.statement: Same label may hide different business meaning or eligibility.
Wrong grain or denominator can inflate ratios and totals.
Wrong source or broken lineage can make values irreproducible.
Time basis, FX or restatement differences can create false variance.
Targets or filters can be changed to manufacture favorable performance.
risks.mitigation: separate target object and authority log
